# Course resources {.unnumbered}

Each teaching unit has a book page, slide deck, Pluto source, and static notebook preview. Units are grouped below by [workshop](workshop.qmd)(taught live), or provided for self-study.

The capstone uses the versioned [Eyam plague dataset](data/eyam_plague_1666.csv) with [provenance metadata](data/eyam_plague_1666.toml).
